title: Halo CE enemies (standalone version)
load: Bundle: HDE_CE_Covenant_Standalone.pk3 on its own, with any other mods (Core + Covenant + voices).   Separate packs: HaloCE_Standalone_Core.pk3 -> HaloCE_Standalone_Covenant.pk3 / _Flood / _Sentinels / _Marines -> HaloCE_Enemies_Voices.pk3, or HaloCE_Standalone_Merged.pk3 for everything. Never load the bundle together with HaloCE_Standalone_Core.

bundle.name: HDE_CE_Covenant_Standalone
header: // Halo CE enemies, standalone bundle: the Covenant (Grunts, Jackals, Elites, Hunters, and the Digsite add-on's Drinol +
// Cyberdemon boss, Slug Men, carbine / pulse-carbine Elites, Blind Wolf, Thorn Beast, Engineer, Drones, Brutes),
// the enemy dialogue, and the Core code it uses (enemy API, projectile library, loot drops, replacement handler).
// Needs no other pk3; load it with any other mods. Don't load HaloCE_Standalone_Core with it.
